cases.name: Danice Leah Day
cases.about:
She was a waitress at Dos Rios restaurant in Monte Vista, CO.

Her Find-a-Grave said, "She spent her early childhood in Medicine Bow and Laramie Wyoming and also in Del Norte and Monte Vista, Colo. Danice went to elementary school in Medicine Bow and moved to Colorado. She then attended junior high and part of high school in Laramie. Danice had a close-knit group of friends in both Colorado and Wyoming. Danice will be remembered by family and friends for her bright, beautiful, and positive spirit. She will also be remembered as a loving, caring mother of two small children, Joshua and Kaylie. Her children became the light of her life."
cases.narrative: In 6/2009, a dive team found her charred bones in a welded-shut oil barrel at the bottom of Lyman Lake in AZ. Forensic pathologist Leon Kelly testified in court that the nearly 1000 bone fragments and femur found in the barrel revealed “the extent to which the perpetrator went to disfigure the body.”
